positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationStatus
positions.frame: how is the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration established and verified?
positions.why: All four expressions cohere around the calibration record of the Kestrelwood spectrograph: src-1 asserts the calibration at 88.4 MHz, src-2 asserts verification against June reference plates across the full observing band, src-3 identifies the instrument, and src-4 declaratively summarizes the calibration frequency and verification basis. Together they form one directional read of what constitutes the instrument's calibration status.
